content: Bulus di tegzirt n Malta
Awarni man aya nefhem, belli tagzirt-a qqaren as Malta.
Ibarraniyyen inni din izedɣen ggin akidneɣ mliḥ aṭṭas, am ssiɣen ict n tmessi d tameqqrant uca řaɣan aneɣ marra ɣarsen, ḥima ad neẓɣeř minzi anẓar tuɣa iccat aṭṭas u tuɣa tesmeḍ.
Umi tuɣa issmun Bulus aɛurric n ikecwaḍ, issars i-ten x tmessi, xenni s řeḥmu nni iffeɣ-dd ijj n ufiɣar uca iqqes as deg ufus.
Umi ẓrin ibarraniyyen aqa yuyeř ufiɣar ɣar ufus nnes, nnan: “Ad taɣ bnadem-a d aqettař, war t tejji ‘lalla řḥeqq’ ad iddar, waxxa injem-dd zi řebḥar.”
Maca Bulus izzerz s ufus nnes, immenḍar afiɣar di tmessi, břa ma d as temsar uřa d ict n druct.

Maca nitni tuɣa ttrajan ad yuff řexdenni uca ad iwḍa ad immet. Maca umi ẓrin, awarni řami rajan aṭṭas, belli war d as temsar uřa d ict n řḥajjet taɛeffant, ibeddeř řhard nsen, nnan, aqa-t d ijj n arebbi.
Tuɣa d jjihet nni iyyaren i yeǧan d agřa n ijj n weryaz umi qqaren Publiyus. Netta tuɣa d azeǧif n tegzirt, issnewju aneɣ s řxar třata n wussan di taddart nnes.
Babas n Publiyus tuɣa dayes timessi d řeḥriq. Dayes ijj n řeḥřac n teqqrint. Yudef Bulus ɣares, iẓẓuǧ, issars xas afus uca issgenfa i-t.
Umi imsar man aya, usin-dd ɣares inneɣni n tegzirt inni tuɣa ɣar iǧa imehřac uca ttwassgenfan.
Karmen xaneɣ ina s waṭṭas n ccan. Umi nruḥ nbeḥḥar ssenni, wcin aneɣ min tuɣa neḥwaj.
Awaḍ n Bulus ɣar Ruma
Awarni teřt n iyuren nruḥ, nbeḥḥar deg ijj n uɣarrabu zi Iskandariyya i isseɛdun řmecta di tegzirt, tuɣa xas arcam n ‘Tecniwin’.
Umi dd-niweḍ ɣar Siragusa, neqqim din třata n wussan.
Ssenni ndur uca niweḍ-dd ɣar Rixiyum. Awarni ijj n wass ikkar-dd usemmiḍ n tcarmin uca niweḍ-dd deg ijj n řmijař n tnayen n wussan ɣar Putiyuli, ict n tendint di Iṭalya.
Dinni i nufa tawmat nni zzayneɣ ittaren ad kidsen neqqim, uca neqqim akidsen sebɛa n wussan. Xenni nruḥ ɣar Ruma.
Umi sřin tawmat di Ruma x umeddur nneɣ, usin-dd ḥima ad kidneɣ mmeřqan deg wazzay umi qqaren ‘Apiyus Furus’ u ɣar ‘Třata n Tḥuna’. Umi ten iẓra Bulus, icekkar AREBBI uca ittwacejjeɛ.
Umi dd-niweḍ ɣar Ruma, iwca řqebṭan x mya ttesriḥ i Bulus maḥend ad izdeɣ mani ixs netta, ak-d ijj n uɛessas wenni t i ɣa iḥḍan.
Ameřqi n Bulus ak-d Wudayen di Ruma
Awarni třata n wussan iřaɣa Bulus i imcennɛen n Wudayen. Ařami munen, inna asen:
“A iryazen tawmat, waxxa necc war ggiɣ uřa d ict n řḥajjet ḍidd i řgens niɣ ḍidd i Ccariɛa n řejdud inu, aqa ttwasellmeɣ d ameḥbus zi Urcalim deg ifassen n Irumaniyyen.
Awarni řami d ayi beqqcen, tuɣa xsen ad ayi arxun minzi war dayi ufin uřa d ict n řḥajjet tessdaheǧ řmewt.
Maca umi ɛekksen Wudayen x man aya, s uɣiř xafi ad ssgeɛɛdeɣ ddeɛwet inu ɣar qayṣar, maca břa ma ad ɣari yiři ijj n ucetci x řgens inu.
X ssibbet-a ttareɣ ḥima ad kenniw ẓareɣ uca ad kiwem ssiwřeɣ. Minzi di ssibbet n usitem n Israil, aqa ayi carfeɣ s ssnesřet-a.”
Maca nitni nnan as: “War xak neṭṭif ca tibratin zi Yahudiyya uca uřa d ijj n tawmat war dd-yusi da wi innan niɣ issiwřen xak s ca n řɛib.
Maca neccin nexs ad zzayek nseř min tᵉttwařid, minzi zi jjihet n tebridt-a, aqa nessen belli ttɛekksen tt mani ma.”

Nitni mɛahaden akides x ijj n wass, uca munen. Aṭṭas i-dd-yusin ɣar wemcan mani izeddeɣ. Netta tuɣa ittfessar asen Tageldit n AREBBI, am icehhed u yarezzu ad ten isseqneɛ zi jjihet n Yasuɛ, zi Ccariɛa n Musa u zeg inabiyyen, zi řefjar ařami d tameddit.
Ca ttwassqenɛen s wawařen nnes, maca inneɣni war ttwassqenɛen ca.
Nitni ffɣen xas am war dd-usin ak-d wayawya. Xenni inna asen Bulus ɛad awař-a: “S řḥeqq issiweř Arruḥ Iqeddsen x uqemmum n Icaɛya i řejdud nwem, inna:
‘Ruḥ ɣar řgens-a, ini asen: ‘S useǧi ad tesřem, war tfehhemem, s tmuɣři ad texzarem, war tᵉttwiřim,

minzi uř n řgens-a aqa idweř iqseḥ, Imezzuɣen nsen ssḍeqřen ten i useǧi, u tiṭṭawin nsen qqnen tent, maḥend war ttwiřin s tiṭṭawin nsen, war ttesřin s imezzuɣen nsen, war fehhemen s wuř nsen, ařami war ɣari dekkwiřen uca ad asen ɣfareɣ.’
Man aya ittxeṣṣa ad tessnem: Areqqas n usenjem-a n AREBBI aqa ittwassekk-dd i řegnus uca uřa d nitni ad ɣares sřen.”
Awarni řami inna man aya, ffɣen Wudayen, am tuɣa ttemcubbucen jar asen aṭṭas.
Bulus icra ict n taddart, ixeǧeṣ i-tt s yixef nnes, izeddeɣ dayes tnayen n iseggʷusa. Tuɣa ittareḥḥab s marra inni tuɣa ɣares dd-ittasen,
ittbarreḥ s Tgeldit n AREBBI, isseřmad x Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ s bṭayṭay u břa ma tᵉttwassbedd uřa d ict n tɛenkrift.
